ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan a receive QR code shown on another screen, or take a photo to send in a chat. The camera opens only when you tap Take Photo or scan; when scanning, Tapiro reads the code only.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save a payee's receive QR code to Photos so you can scan it from your wallet app. Tapiro only adds this one image.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sort nearby bounties by how far they are, or use where you are now as a bounty's place. Used only while you use Tapiro.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Records your voice when you talk to Tapir, to turn it into text in the field. Recording starts only when you tap the microphone and ends when you tap stop.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Turns what you say to Tapir into text. Your phone recognises it first; if it can’t, and you have agreed, the recording goes to Alibaba Cloud (Singapore).
